data_boundary: Only original Rust unit-test records. No user data, credentials, browser state, or external provider calls.
copy_rules: SQLite VACUUM INTO snapshots and XLSX copied as binary artifacts. creator-candidate/creator.sqlite is a native SQLite VACUUM INTO copy of the original Rust WAL database. JSON retained with a final newline using apply_patch; candidate prepared/selected golden SHA256 tests cover original bytes before that final newline.
expiration: Import snapshots retain original expiration timestamps. An expired original operation is verified expired, then a real fresh preparation must match the original Rust plan fingerprint before confirmation. No clock replacement or expiration extension.
